title: Quality of life and follow-up of germ cell tumor patients
summary: The aim of this observational study is to record the quality of life of germ cell tumor patients, the recording of late toxicities due to chemotherapy and patient adherence to follow-up examinations.

interventions.name: It is an open prospective multicenter observational study of germ cell tumor patients. As part of the initial diagnosis, germ cell tumor patients receive a questionnaire to assess tumor-specific quality of life, demographic parameters and the use of cryopreservation prior to therapy.
